notes: Envelope: audit_dead_stores returns exactly dead_stores, findings, run_metrics, status, coverage. status is the legacy 'pass'/'fail' from make_component_envelope; adapt_component_result keeps it only as legacy_status_ignored. coverage is 'verified' or 'could_not_verify' and adapt_component_result keeps it (recomputed from findings). run_metrics is an unknown top-level key and adapt_component_result COPIES it through unchanged (tested).

Digest: run_metrics.stale_locks_vs_now_count depends on the wall clock (now) and must be stored outside the fingerprinted report. Nothing in the section depends on now or clock, except that a run cut by the 20 s time budget reports truncated_by=time_budget (a coverage fact, never silent).

Self-contained config: with only profile_path the module reads <profile>/config.yaml itself (1 MiB cap, O_NOFOLLOW, never a credential file) for plugins.enabled, plugins.disabled, skills.external_dirs, display.pet.enabled. Missing file means Hermes defaults; unreadable/unparsable/duplicate-key file adds config_unreadable; an active managed scope (write_settings._has_managed_overlay, HERMES_MANAGED_DIR or the default managed dir) adds managed_config_overlay; ${VAR} in external_dirs makes that check unverified. Explicit keyword arguments (including None) win over the file.
schema_keys includes the section name dead_stores itself: store.finalize_run serializes the whole report payload, and a payload key outside SCHEMA_KEYS is replaced by an hmac: sealed key.

Finding persistence: affected_identities and source_paths of every finding are fixed rel_source labels listed in vocabulary ('.', profile-exports, plugins, plugin-data, cache, sessions, logs, backups, locks, vendor-skills, pets); source_paths[].path goes through the _PATH_FIELDS rule and survives only because the value is in VOCABULARY.

audit_surface fallbacks: _unknown('dead_stores', ...) emits rule id dead_stores.unverified and adapt_component_result can emit dead_stores.operational_error, both with interpolated consequences; they are not emitted by this module and are not in rule_ids here.

Free strings: the section emits no tokenisable string. Every free string is an absolute path, built from the RESOLVED home (os.path.realpath), to an existing folder inside the home; EvidenceSerializer.scalar resolves and lstat's it and returns it unchanged (tested: sealed == raw, no dict with an hmac field, two runs with fresh serializer keys give identical sealed section and findings). The paths must still exist when the report is serialized. Names with no existing item (plugins.enabled entries without a folder, symlinked plugin folders, manifest names, hook names, pet slug) are emitted as counts and vocabulary reasons only: enabled_missing entries are {reason, path|null}; the enabled_symlinked name list was removed (enabled_symlinked_count stays) because a symlink path would resolve to its target outside the home.
Paths whose component is credential-named (policy.credential_path or the module's credential filename pattern) are emitted as null; the entry and its bytes are still counted.

Changed in this wiring pass: run_metrics moved out of the section; attachments/composer_pastes oldest_year_month string replaced by integer oldest_year/oldest_month; unrotated_logs.files[].rel_path replaced by log_location label + in_named_profile bool; plugin/plugin-data/clone name and rel_path fields replaced by absolute path fields; enabled_symlinked list removed; parked_name_label and name_pattern_label added; config.yaml read by the module.
